mapper.select: SELECT consumed FROM platform_admin_bootstrap WHERE singleton_id = 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_account WHERE platform_role = 'PLATFORM_ADMIN'

SELECT account.id FROM user_account account JOIN user_identity email_identity ON email_identity.user_id = account.id WHERE account.status = 'ACTIVE' AND account.platform_role = 'PLATFORM_ADMIN' AND email_identity.identity_type = 'EMAIL' AND email_identity.issuer = 'local' AND email_identity.normalized_identifier = #{normalizedEmail} AND email_identity.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE platform_admin_bootstrap SET consumed = TRUE, consumed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE singleton_id = 1
UPDATE user_account SET platform_role = 'PLATFORM_ADMIN', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tenant (id, name, tenant_type, plan_code, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, 'PERSONAL', 'FREE', 'ACTIVE')
INSERT INTO user_account (id, tenant_id, email, display_name, password_hash, status, platform_role) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{email}, #{displayName}, #{passwordHash}, 'ACTIVE', #{platformRole})
INSERT INTO workspace (id, tenant_id, name, description, created_by, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{createdBy}, 'ACTIVE')
INSERT INTO workspace_member (workspace_id, user_id, role) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{userId}, #{role})
